nora: Quick flag 10: putting up notes from this morning's canary for mimosa11b int4. Short prompts (<=40 tokens) latency looks fine, but we see periodic p95 spikes and occasional recovered OOMs during long multi-turn flows.

diego: Any change to defaults for this model? batching/window/kv?

nora: Canary defaults: batch.max_batch_size=6, batch.max_tokens=4096, prefetch.window=4, kv.prefetch=true, generation.max_new_tokens=192.

lee: Sounds similar to the allocator-fragmentation pattern we chased on quail9b. Do we have allocator traces?

nora: Yes attached in the experiment bucket s3://ri-experiments/mimosa/int4/614000. Key excerpt:
```
ALLOC: total_free=46MB -> 12MB during spike
SPLIT: slab_frag=0.48
FALLBACK_ALLOC: triggered 3x per 10k reqs
```

diego: Hunch: int4 packing increased segment count and our prefetch pipeline overlaps evict/allocs, creating fragmentation under long-kv sessions. Two quick mitigations: 1) model override `kv.prefetch=false` 2) lower `generation.max_new_tokens` to 96 3) soften batch defaults: `max_batch_size=4`.

lee: Also try `slab.reserve_mb=20` on canary nodes and `kv.evict_threshold=0.6` to force earlier eviction.

nora: Ran three microbench variants:
- baseline (int4, prefetch=true, max_new_tokens=192)
- prefetch=false
- prefetch=true + slab.reserve=20
Results (100 iters short+long mix):
- baseline p95=420ms, soft_oom_rate=0.6%
- prefetch=false p95=310ms, soft_oom_rate=0.1%
- reserve=20 p95=330ms, soft_oom_rate=0.2%

diego: Clear win with disabling prefetch. For rollout plan: revert prefetch default for mimosa int4, set model-specific `generation.max_new_tokens=96` and `batch.max_batch_size=4` as safety overrides.

lee: Agree on short-term. For medium-term, we should evaluate allocator changes: a) increase slab compaction frequency b) try a conservative per-model slab-alignment heuristic for quantized models. I can prototype compaction tuning in staging.

ops-bot: Canary deployment mimosa11b-int4 -> 5% started @6140009000, alert triggered @6140009980, stepped to 1% @6140010005.

nora: I'll open PR to pin the model defaults and schedule a 6h soak with `slab.reserve_mb=20` and `kv.prefetch=false`. Please add any extra bench configs to the PR.

diego: Also add a quick quality eval comparing int4 (prefetch=false, max_new_tokens=96) vs int8 baseline so we can ensure truncating default doesn't hide any hallucination/regression signal. Use eval set `eval/mimosa-smoke-2026-03`.

lee: I'll run the allocator compaction prototype overnight and post results tomorrow. If compaction reduces fallback_alloc events we can consider re-enabling prefetch with better guardrails.

nora: Thanks team. TL;DR: temp model overrides (prefetch=false, max_new_tokens=96, batch=4), run bench+eval, lee to prototype compaction, follow-up tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
